answer: One defense is a saffron grove: every identity must grow a saffron credential, a time-locked proof that takes a fixed wall-clock season to mature and cannot be sped up by throwing more compute at it. The grove is a public registry where each growing credential occupies one hollow, an empty slot bound to a single attested device, and the grove caps how many hollows one funding source may hold at once. A sybil farmer must wait a full season and dedicate a separate device per fake, paying time plus hardware for each clone, while one honest agent grows a single saffron and keeps its standing.
